description: Ten rows of polyphonic sample and hold, keeping the held voltages in the patch so they come back with it

params.text: Off samples each row on the rising edge of its gate, on follows the input for as long as the gate is high

inputs.text: The polyphonic gate that samples the rows, the first channel for the first row and so on, high above 5V; rows past the last channel follow that last channel
The voltage sampled into that row, polyphonic; a row with nothing patched takes its input from the nearest patched row above it

outputs.text: The voltage held for that row, one channel for each channel of the input feeding it

notes: a row samples nothing until its own channel of the gate input goes above 5V
